description: Ministry of Urban Development, Water Supply and Housing Facilities - Transferring the Water Supply Scheme of Bandarawela Municipal Council to the National Water Supply and Drainage Board under Section 64(1) of National Water Supply Supply and Drainage Board Act, No. 02 of 1974
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with the transfer of land and property (including lands, buildings, water pipes, installations, and contracts) from the Bandarawela Municipal Council to the National Water Supply and Drainage Board. It contains detailed schedules listing specific land parcels with their locations, extents, and title details, along with descriptions of water storage tanks and other property assets. This falls squarely under land and property-related matters, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
